findings_qualitative.value: J0129 shows velocity gradient with turbulent clumps; J1044 shows no clear rotation and a multi-peaked [CII] spectrum offset from CO(6-5)

evidence.quote: The [C II]-emitting gas in the central region of SDSS J1044-0125 does not show a clear sign of rotation.

claims.experiment: Ring-averaged [CII] and FIR surface brightnesses compared with other samples
claims.result: Ratios 0.0001-0.001, decreasing with increasing Sigma_FIR up to ~2e12 Lsun/kpc2
claims.finding: Similar to compact starbursts; local conditions drive the deficit

evidence.quote: The resolved [CII]-FIR ratios are decreasing with increasing $\rm \Sigma_{FIR}$ toward the center

claims.finding: Ratio not significantly above local relation

evidence.quote: Thus, it is unlikely that the black hole-to-host mass ratio of SDSS J0129-0035 is significantly above the local relationship.
